E4Plus1.uk.description: WrestleMania: Murray buys WrestleMania tickets to spend time with Barry and Adam, only to find that the tickets are fakes and they can't get in. Guest starring Hulk Hogan. (S7 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pilot: US comedy about a group of New York City police detectives. A talented but carefree detective is taken aback when a strict new captain takes over at his precinct. (S1 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Cindy poses as a taxi driver in a desperate attempt to get answers. Meanwhile, the village gathers to support Ste, and a resident is left feeling awkward.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: A new friendship leads Ste to relapse. Dee Dee springs into action when Nancy's health takes a turn. And a father confronts his daughter.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Birmingham, competitive Corinne and Dal hope that their attention to detail will give them the edge. Jack and Georgie serve home-cooked favourites. And James and Adele do fine dining.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Barefoot Bob's: Gordon visits Barefoot Bob's beachside restaurant in Massachusetts, where husband and wife Marc and Lisa struggle to attract customers during the winter months. (S6 Ep5) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon revisits Café Hon in Baltimore, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in New Jersey, to find out whether the owners have taken his advice on board. (S6 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
E4Plus1.uk.description: Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. In a Christmas special, kids get upset that Santa has eaten their cookies. (S30 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
E4Plus1.uk.description: Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny and memorable moments. On Halloween night, tricks and treats are in store. And you'd better beware of jump scares galore... (S33 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Friend with Benefit: When Lisa becomes friends with Harper, a new girl at school whose family are extremely wealthy, Homer befriends Harper's father. (S27 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa with an 'S': Homer loses a large sum of money playing poker with Broadway legend Laney Fontaine, who takes Lisa under her wing and transforms her into a showbiz kid. (S27 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Barthood: Bart's coming-of-age story is told, chronicling his life from youth to adulthood. But his tense relationship with Homer and being overshadowed by Lisa shape him. (S27 Ep9/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Girl Code: Marge posts a photo on social media that gets Homer fired, so he returns to his old job as a dish-washer in a Greek restaurant. Lisa creates an app. (S27 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mini Murray: Barry wants money to buy an expensive new pair of basketball shoes, so Murray hires him to work at his furniture shop so he can earn it. (S1 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Why're You Hitting Yourself?: Determined to get Pops to settle down, Beverly plays matchmaker for her father and pairs him up with a woman called Sophia. (S1 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Alliance: Haley's plan for a fun-filled girls' day with Rainer Shine's teen daughter may be more angst-filled than expected. And Luke finds himself in a compromising position. (S8 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Snow Ball: Manny and Luke organise the school's lavish winter dance but end up in over their heads due to a texting error. Can they fix it before the end of the night? (S8 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Ringmaster Keifth: Cam tries to make up for his Thanksgiving debacle by hosting a New Year feast. And Phil's not sure how to feel about his dad dating his childhood babysitter. (S8 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sarge & Pea: Cam is incensed when a rude parent robs him of a precious Lily moment during her dance recital. Jay, Claire and Mitch unexpectedly run into Dede at a family wedding. (S8 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa's Belly: Bart and Lisa have to take steroids after getting an infection at a waterpark - and the new drugs have some alarming side effects, particularly for Lisa. (S33 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire: Smithers tires of Mr Burns' indifference and finds solace in the arms of affectionate fashion designer Michael de Graaf. (S33 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mothers and Other Strangers: Homer does therapy to cope with missing his mother, sending him on a trip down memory lane, to when he and Grampa went on a road trip to find her. (S33 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Made Maggie: Marge sends Homer to find a godfather for an as-yet-unbaptised Maggie. And who'd make a better godfather than mafia don Fat Tony? (S33 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: There's an emotional reunion between siblings, and Dee Dee finds herself the centre of attention in class. Elsewhere, Gemma's forced to reveal her past when a new face arrives in Hollyoaks.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Tagger: When Peralta turns up late for morning roll call, Captain Holt responds by assigning him to a minor graffiti case and then closely monitoring his every move. (S1 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Ladies of London: The New...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Reign - Brand new series: Myka has a polo-themed, toff-tastic birthday bash. Missé attempts the mend the rift between Margo and Mark-Francis. Good luck, Missé... (Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Down Under
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Marina resolves to be less guarded in her love life, then immediately regrets it. Tzarina and Lara are, as always, at loggerheads. But no one wants to apologise. (S3 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the TV this time: Planet Earth III, Mamma Mia!, I Have a Dream, Surviving Paradise, Uncanny, Celebrity Race Across the World, and Crack Addicts. (S22 Ep8)

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Fiat 500: A rusty 1970 Fiat 500 goes under the hammer - Derek reckons it's the kind of vehicle that is so iconic that it has to be saved. S7 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Oxford to Reading: Robbie's narrowboat gets a makeover before he explores the River Thames, he moors in Abingdon and tackles an emergency DIY repair to fix a leak. S6 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Reading to Windsor: Robbie visits a former Beatle's home in Henley, uncovers horror history in Marlow and struggles to find a mooring in Maidenhead on the River Thames. S6 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Windsor to Godalming: While exploring the Wey and Godalming Navigations, Robbie gets caught in a storm and falls off his narrowboat. He also uncovers rock history in Guildford. S6 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Russia with Simon Reeve
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Simon journeys from Crimea to St Petersburg, meeting the owner of a safari park and an inspirational doctor, before joining the fighters at a martial arts club. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Porridge

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Porridge
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Hustler: Ronnie Barker is Fletcher, who proves you can't keep an old lag, or pig, down. He dreams up a novel way to relieve the boredom - and a few perks for himself, of course. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Porridge
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: A Night In: If you had to share a cell, Ronnie Barker would be fine company. Fletch and Godber try to get through a night banged up as they imagine what they'd be doing 'outside'. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Porridge
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: A Day Out: A day on the moors digging drains for the council is bound to offer an opportunity for Fletch to take advantage - especially with Mr Barrowclough in charge. Classic laughs. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Porridge
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Ways and Means: Criminally funny sitcom. Fletch falls out with the governor and loses all his credibility. But he hopes to get back into his good books via a cosy job in the library. S1 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Porridge
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Men without Women: Only Ronnie Barker could make prison funny. When Fletcher assumes the role of agony aunt to his fellow inmates, he ends up writing letters home to their loved ones. S1 Ep6
